segments.sensitive: An unusually large number of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several managing eczema or acne, report no irritation, burning, or flare-ups, several specifically praising it as fragrance-appropriate for reactive skin; one longtime sensitive-skin user of other CeraVe products instead found this particular balm ineffective and unpleasant, though not irritating.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it leaves their skin feeling hydrated and supple rather than stripped, including one who switched to it specifically during a dry, rough patch; one reviewer instead says her skin was dried out after use.
segments.oily: Two reviewers with oily skin say it works well without adding shine or oiliness; one reviewer explicitly says the balm is not for oily skin, since it did nothing for her sebaceous filaments.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as mature, alongside dry and sensitive, found the balm easy to emulsify and gentle enough for her routine.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the balm leaves skin feeling soft, hydrated, and never stripped, several specifically contrasting it with other makeup removers that dried them out; one reviewer instead reports her skin felt dried out after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who says most cleansing balms she has tried disrupt her skin barrier reports her skin stayed calm and happy when using this one alongside a gentle toner.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her dark marks faded when she left the balm on her skin longer than instructed, though this is not the recommended use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts and say it does not clog pores; a few others report new breakouts on their cheeks or jawline after starting the product, with one noting it happened only when she skipped a proper cleanse afterward.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it rinses away cleanly without leaving an oily residue once washed off with a follow-up cleanser; a few describe the balm itself as feeling greasy or leaving an oily film, particularly if not rinsed thoroughly.

extraits.texte: I bought this product because I was running out of my regular cleansing balm and this was the only one available to me. I trust the CeraVe brand and have used their hydrating cleanser, daily lotion, and cream for years on my sensitive skin so I had high expectations. This is actually probably the worst cleansing balm I've tried and I'm surpsied that CeraVe has even put this on the market. First, I much prefer other balms with little scoops in the packaging to help keep your product clean - this one does not have that. Second, after you scoop this out with your finger (gross) and start rubbing it in your hands, not all of the product melts. When applying it on the skin, it has such a pungent chemical smell which makes the whole washing your face thing for self care reasons a very unpleasant task. It's almost unbearable and very unlike a typical CeraVe product which is why I'm so surprised. Lastly, you go through this whole ordeal of putting this stuff on your face all for it to not work at all and leave a waxy, slimy residue on your skin - along with makeup that it didn't even take off - that you will need to scrub off with a washcloth at the end before continuing with your routine. I brought this with me on a weekend trip and tried it multiple times and I could not get this balm to work for me. extraits.titre: Removes makeup (sort of) but caused me to break out
extraits.texte: Bought this cleansing balm because I generally trust CeraVe skin products - I use their AM and PM moisturizers regularly with almost no problems. I bought this cleansing balm in March 2024, and I noticed that since around that time, I've been having regular breakouts on my cheeks and jawline. (Disclaimer: I have PCOS so I'm already acne-prone, but for about a year before that my acne was well under control.) Given the timing and the fact that I'd changed nothing in my diet or skincare routine, I highly suspect this cleansing balm is the culprit. It does remove makeup for the most part, but I found that I still had to wipe it off even after rinsing with water before going in with my normal cleanser. I wouldn't buy this product again.
It is more waxy than a typical cleansing balm would be. It gets off surface level impurities but it does nothing for my sebaceous filaments. You can find better for a better price as well.

extraits.titre: Great product for sensitive skin and removing makeup with...
extraits.texte: As you can see from the second picture, I have some pretty severe facial eczema. I have been using this product for about a month to take my mascara off and it has a buttery melting effect when applied and leaves my skin feeling very hydrated. It takes my makeup off without damaging my skin or my lashes. It smells pleasant but not overly fragrant. I cannot tolerate overly fragrant products on my skin because it will cause my skin to have a really bad flare up from my skin condition. I would highly recommend to anyone with sensitive skin in need of a good makeup remover.

I usually don't use oil balms because of many unhappy experiences but I needed one that was gentle and fragrance free to remove my balm foundation. I was pleasantly surprised at how easy it was to emulsify and rinse off easily. Make sure to make balm into liquid and rinse face a few times. I follow with my Cerave hydrating cleanser for a 2nd cleanse. I have dry, sensitive, and mature skin for reference. Only down side is the size of the jar.

I have very sensitive, acne prone skin. I have to be incredibly careful when implementing a new product. I tried this as an alternative to washing my face at night, which may sound crazy, but doing this has completely restored my skincare routine and I now have a nice, dewy low. I always make sure to rinse after using it, of course. I will say it's not very effective at taking off mascara, though.

I switched to this when my skin was going through a dry/rough spell because I thought it'd be gentler and this is my favorite remover. It cuts through makeup and leaves my skin feeling supple and hydrated.
